snippet.title: SILKROAD Project - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist SILKROAD Project on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1243550/SilkRoad_Project/

SILKROAD Project is a fast-paced third-person action game where stylish combat meets guesthouse management in a vibrant and unique world.

Chain spectacular combos with a dual-character combat system, then slow down and manage your caravanserai by welcoming guests, organizing their activities, and growing your inn into a legendary place.

💥 Fast-paced dual-character action combat
🏮 Daily guesthouse management gameplay
🎮 Deep mini-games inspired by classic gameplay mechanics but with a twist
✨ A colorful world full of charm and adventure

Wishlist now and support the project!
